title: Price lists
purpose: Find staff lists that supply per-sample test prices to quote drafts.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Project managers and admins can use price lists and quotes. Other staff roles do not grant this access. Admin includes the project manager role. A superuser flag alone supplies no application role.

sections.title: Find and arrange records
paragraphs: There is no bulk action or selection across pages. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; correct or clear them. No matches means the filters found nothing. An unfiltered empty list means no eligible records exist.

items.label: Search
items.description: Search list names and staff descriptions. Case-insensitive partial matching trims surrounding spaces and accepts at most 200 characters. Search and filters apply together to the full record set.

items.label: Status
items.description: All initially; choose Active or Inactive.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters and return to page 1. Current sorting and page size are kept.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search, filters, sorting and page settings and return to this list’s defaults. Removing one active filter keeps the others and returns to page 1.

items.label: Sort
items.description: Default order is Name. Select a sortable heading to change direction. Sortable columns: Name, Priced tests, Status and Created. Sorting applies to all matching records, with record identity as a stable tie-breaker.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 50 or 100. A change returns to page 1 and preserves other query settings. Show applies the choice without automatic submission.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Move through matching records. The footer shows the visible range, count and page. Unavailable directions are disabled. Invalid page numbers resolve to an available page; unsupported page sizes are refused.

items.label: Columns
items.description: With enhanced controls, show/hide columns and use Move up / Move down or drag headings to reorder. Name is always shown and fixed. Changes apply immediately and are saved in this browser for this table; they do not filter or change records.

items.label: Reset columns / Done / Close
items.description: Reset columns restores shipped visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog; changes already apply.

items.label: Name
items.description: Select the name to edit the list. Optional staff description appears below, shortened to 90 characters.

items.label: Priced tests
items.description: Number of test price entries, including existing entries for tests no longer active.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active permits new quote selection. Inactive prevents new selection; an existing draft can retain its already selected list.

items.label: Created
items.description: Original creation date/time in laboratory local time.

items.label: New price list
items.description: Open a new list and price catalog tests. The empty state offers the same action.
